description: This app connects ChatGPT to the user's granted Roam graphs so that the agent can read from and write to the graphs. Using this app, ChatGPT can assist you by doing: search and retrieve pages or blocks, run Roam and datalog queries, append notes, create pages or blocks, edit content, manage comments, and delete selected pages or blocks when permitted.
